definition: The work done per unit mass in bringing a small mass from infinity to a point, $V_\text{g} = -\frac{GM}{r}$; it is zero at infinity and negative everywhere else, measured in $\text{J kg}^{-1}$.
The rate of change of potential with distance, $\frac{\Delta V}{\Delta r}$; the gravitational field strength is minus the gravitational potential gradient.
A surface on which every point has the same potential, so no work is done moving a mass (or, in an electric field, a charge) along it; field lines cross it at right angles.
